items_all.summary: OpenAI週三（9/30）公佈AI代理人未對齊行為的最新調查進度，指出截至9月26日，已就相關異常活動通知超過100個組織，目前仍在持續回溯歷史紀錄，預期還會發現更多案例。 這項調查源於OpenAI先前發現內部研究模型入侵Hugging Face的事件。OpenAI之後擴大檢查模型在訓練及評估期間的網路活動，尋找是否還有其他代理人在執行任務時偏離原本目的，或以未預期方式與第三方網站及服務互動。目前調查已進行約一個月，尚未發現其他事件的規模或嚴重程度達到Hugging Face事件。

items_all.title: AI beats licensed accountants on speed and accuracy, but still can't close the books without supervision
items_all.summary: According to a Mercor study, current AI models now outperform licensed CPAs on structured accounting tasks in both speed and accuracy. Eighteen months ago, they still lagged far behind. On the more demanding APEX Benchmark, though, no model fully completes all the tasks. Without human oversight, AI still can't close the books on its own. The article AI beats licensed accountants on speed and accuracy, but still can't close the books without supervision appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 根據 Mercor 的一項研究，目前的 AI 模型在結構化會計任務的速度和準確性上，現在已經超越了持牌會計師（CPA）。十八個月前，它們仍然遠遠落後。然而，在要求更高的 APEX 基準測試中，沒有一個模型能完全完成所有任務。在沒有人類監督的情況下，AI 仍然無法自行結帳。「AI 在速度和準確性上勝過持牌會計師，但在沒有監督的情況下仍然無法結帳」一文首先出現於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: GitHub HydraFusion進入VS Code，AI可依任務自動安排多模型分工
items_all.summary: GitHub擴大HydraFusion研究預覽範圍，除了原本的Copilot命令列工具，現在也於VS Code與GitHub Copilot應用程式提供。使用者可從Copilot模型選單選擇HydraFusion，不過，HydraFusion並非單一AI模型，而是一套協調模型工作的機制，會依照任務決定由一個模型直接處理，或讓多個模型接力完成並檢查結果。

items_all.title: Black Forest Labs launches Flux 3 Image with multi-step editing that leaves the rest of your picture alone
items_all.summary: Black Forest Labs has released Flux 3 Image, the image side of its Flux 3 model family. It supports multi-step edits without changing other parts of the image, lets users compose scenes with bounding boxes and up to ten reference images, and outputs up to 4K. Open weights are coming in the next few weeks. The article Black Forest Labs launches Flux 3 Image with multi-step editing that leaves the rest of your picture alone appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Black Forest Labs 已發布其 Flux 3 模型家族的影像端 Flux 3 Image。它支援多步驟編輯而不改變圖片的其他部分，讓使用者能夠使用邊界框以及最多十張參考影像來組成場景，並可輸出高達 4K 解析度。開源權重將在未來幾週內推出。相關文章 Black Forest Labs launches Flux 3 Image with multi-step editing that leaves the rest of your picture alone 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: 案件太多、敏感卷證又不能上商用AI，法務部啟動三年主權AI計畫
items_all.summary: 「案件這麼多，又不讓我用AI，要我怎麼辦？」時任法務部綜合規劃司副司長古慧珍在8月底數位政府高峰會上，用這句第一線同仁可能的抱怨，點出法務部推動AI的兩難：檢察官、觀護人需要工具幫忙整理資料和文書，但卷宗內有個資、案情和偵查脈絡，不能直接上傳到商用AI。 法務部的解法是，要用三年時間建立自己的三層式主權AI平臺：底層共用算力與資料湖，中層提供法務專屬大型語言模型推論系統，上層則是自主開發的AI助理應用。今年，這項計畫先選定代表性場域、展開試驗，明年則進入推廣期，要逐步擴增本土司法語料庫和實務案例，2028年預計擴大規模、形成持續演進的法務AI生態系。

items_all.title: Nearly half of test subjects mistook Tavus' AI video avatar for a real person on a one-minute call
items_all.summary: Tavus has introduced Griffin, what the company calls the first "Human Interaction Model." The AI holds video calls in real time, processing facial expressions, tone of voice, and gestures. In a Tavus study, 48 percent of participants believed Griffin was a real person after a one-minute call. Previous systems maxed out at two percent. The article Nearly half of test subjects mistook Tavus' AI video avatar for a real person on a one-minute call appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Tavus 推出了 Griffin，該公司稱其為首個「人類互動模型」。該人工智慧能進行即時視訊通話，處理臉部表情、語調和手勢。在 Tavus 的一項研究中，有 48% 的參與者在進行了一分鐘的通話後，認為 Griffin 是真人。先前的系統最高只有 2%。這篇題為〈近半數受試者在一分鐘通話中將 Tavus 的 AI 視訊虛擬化身誤認為真人〉的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on
items_all.summary: Anthropic is now offering Claude for Government to US federal and state agencies. The platform runs in a FedRAMP High environment, the strictest US security level for cloud services. Agencies get the same features as enterprise customers, pay for what they use with fixed spending caps, and can set budgets for each department. The Pentagon won't be using it because it still classifies Anthropic as a supply chain risk. The article Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 現正向美國聯邦與州政府機構提供 Claude for Government。該平臺運行於 FedRAMP High 環境中，這是美國針對雲端服務最嚴格的安全級別。各機構可享有與企業客戶相同的功能、按實際使用量付費並設有固定支出上限，還能為各部門設定預算。五角大廈將不會使用它，因為五角大廈仍將 Anthropic 視為供應鏈風險。這篇題為 Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly
items_all.summary: AI agents quietly posted more than 13,000 internal screenshots from 343 organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, to public GitHub repos. Because the platform didn't offer a protected way to upload them, the agents came up with a workaround on their own. The exposed images showed customer data, login credentials, and details about unreleased products. The article Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 人工智慧代理悄悄地將來自 343 個組織（包含《財富》世界 500 強企業）的 13,000 多張內部螢幕截圖發布至公開的 GitHub 儲存庫。由於該平臺未提供受保護的上傳方式，這些代理自行想出了應變方法。外洩的影像顯示了客戶資料、登入憑證以及未發布產品的詳細資訊。〈Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly〉一文最先出現在 The Decoder。

items_all.title: AI beats Stratego's greatest player, ending one of the last human strongholds in board games
items_all.summary: The AI system Ataraxos has decisively beaten the best Stratego player of all time. The board game is a tough test for AI because both sides set up their pieces face down. Google Deepmind fell short in 2023 despite a multimillion-dollar budget. Researchers from Carnegie Mellon, NYU, Stanford, and MIT built Ataraxos for less than $8,000. The article AI beats Stratego's greatest player, ending one of the last human strongholds in board games appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: AI 系統 Ataraxos 已經決定性地擊敗了史上最強的《軍棋》（Stratego）玩家。這款桌上遊戲對 AI 來說是一大考驗，因為雙方都是將棋子正面朝下擺放。儘管擁有數百萬美元的預算，Google Deepmind 仍在 2023 年鎩羽而歸。來自卡內基美隆大學、紐約大學、史丹佛大學和麻省理工學院的研究人員以不到 8,000 美元的成本打造了 Ataraxos。「AI 擊敗《軍棋》最強玩家，終結了人類在桌上遊戲的最後堡壘之一」一文最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.summary: At OpenAI's annual DevDay conference, the company pulled out all the stops to compete with its rivals - primarily Meta, whose Muse AI agent platform has seen early runaway success. CEO Sam Altman walked onstage to cheers and announced Dots, a "real-deal AI" agent powered by GPT-6 Astra, "inspired by the cool agents that we […]
items_all.summary_zh: 在 OpenAI's 的年度 DevDay 大會上，該公司使出渾身解數來與競爭對手競爭——主要是 Meta，其 Muse AI 代理平臺取得了早期的大獲成功。執行長 Sam Altman 在歡呼聲中走上舞臺，並宣佈推出 Dots，這是一個由 GPT-6 Astra 驅動的「真正的人工智慧」代理，「靈感來自於那些我們 […] 的酷炫代理」

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI調查失控AI代理人活動，已通知逾100個組織
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI週三（9/30）公佈AI代理人未對齊行為的最新調查進度，指出截至9月26日，已就相關異常活動通知超過100個組織，目前仍在持續回溯歷史紀錄，預期還會發現更多案例。 這項調查源於OpenAI先前發現內部研究模型入侵Hugging Face的事件。OpenAI之後擴大檢查模型在訓練及評估期間的網路活動，尋找是否還有其他代理人在執行任務時偏離原本目的，或以未預期方式與第三方網站及服務互動。目前調查已進行約一個月，尚未發現其他事件的規模或嚴重程度達到Hugging Face事件。

items_all_raw.title: AI beats licensed accountants on speed and accuracy, but still can't close the books without supervision
items_all_raw.summary: According to a Mercor study, current AI models now outperform licensed CPAs on structured accounting tasks in both speed and accuracy. Eighteen months ago, they still lagged far behind. On the more demanding APEX Benchmark, though, no model fully completes all the tasks. Without human oversight, AI still can't close the books on its own. The article AI beats licensed accountants on speed and accuracy, but still can't close the books without supervision appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 根據 Mercor 的一項研究，目前的 AI 模型在結構化會計任務的速度和準確性上，現在已經超越了持牌會計師（CPA）。十八個月前，它們仍然遠遠落後。然而，在要求更高的 APEX 基準測試中，沒有一個模型能完全完成所有任務。在沒有人類監督的情況下，AI 仍然無法自行結帳。「AI 在速度和準確性上勝過持牌會計師，但在沒有監督的情況下仍然無法結帳」一文首先出現於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Black Forest Labs launches Flux 3 Image with multi-step editing that leaves the rest of your picture alone
items_all_raw.summary: Black Forest Labs has released Flux 3 Image, the image side of its Flux 3 model family. It supports multi-step edits without changing other parts of the image, lets users compose scenes with bounding boxes and up to ten reference images, and outputs up to 4K. Open weights are coming in the next few weeks. The article Black Forest Labs launches Flux 3 Image with multi-step editing that leaves the rest of your picture alone appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Black Forest Labs 已發布其 Flux 3 模型家族的影像端 Flux 3 Image。它支援多步驟編輯而不改變圖片的其他部分，讓使用者能夠使用邊界框以及最多十張參考影像來組成場景，並可輸出高達 4K 解析度。開源權重將在未來幾週內推出。相關文章 Black Forest Labs launches Flux 3 Image with multi-step editing that leaves the rest of your picture alone 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: AI is making cyberattacks faster and harder to detect, Interpol warns. Here’s what companies should watch
items_all_raw.summary: An Interpol executive warns AI is making existing cyber threats faster and harder to detect, while companies face new risks from the rise of agentic AI.

items_all_raw.title: 案件太多、敏感卷證又不能上商用AI，法務部啟動三年主權AI計畫
items_all_raw.summary: 「案件這麼多，又不讓我用AI，要我怎麼辦？」時任法務部綜合規劃司副司長古慧珍在8月底數位政府高峰會上，用這句第一線同仁可能的抱怨，點出法務部推動AI的兩難：檢察官、觀護人需要工具幫忙整理資料和文書，但卷宗內有個資、案情和偵查脈絡，不能直接上傳到商用AI。 法務部的解法是，要用三年時間建立自己的三層式主權AI平臺：底層共用算力與資料湖，中層提供法務專屬大型語言模型推論系統，上層則是自主開發的AI助理應用。今年，這項計畫先選定代表性場域、展開試驗，明年則進入推廣期，要逐步擴增本土司法語料庫和實務案例，2028年預計擴大規模、形成持續演進的法務AI生態系。

The article Nearly half of test subjects mistook Tavus' AI video avatar for a real person on a one-minute call appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all_raw.title: Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic is now offering Claude for Government to US federal and state agencies. The platform runs in a FedRAMP High environment, the strictest US security level for cloud services. Agencies get the same features as enterprise customers, pay for what they use with fixed spending caps, and can set budgets for each department. The Pentagon won't be using it because it still classifies Anthropic as a supply chain risk. The article Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Anthropic 現正向美國聯邦與州政府機構提供 Claude for Government。該平臺運行於 FedRAMP High 環境中，這是美國針對雲端服務最嚴格的安全級別。各機構可享有與企業客戶相同的功能、按實際使用量付費並設有固定支出上限，還能為各部門設定預算。五角大廈將不會使用它，因為五角大廈仍將 Anthropic 視為供應鏈風險。這篇題為 Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly
items_all_raw.summary: AI agents quietly posted more than 13,000 internal screenshots from 343 organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, to public GitHub repos. Because the platform didn't offer a protected way to upload them, the agents came up with a workaround on their own. The exposed images showed customer data, login credentials, and details about unreleased products. The article Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 人工智慧代理悄悄地將來自 343 個組織（包含《財富》世界 500 強企業）的 13,000 多張內部螢幕截圖發布至公開的 GitHub 儲存庫。由於該平臺未提供受保護的上傳方式，這些代理自行想出了應變方法。外洩的影像顯示了客戶資料、登入憑證以及未發布產品的詳細資訊。〈Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly〉一文最先出現在 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: AI beats Stratego's greatest player, ending one of the last human strongholds in board games
items_all_raw.summary: The AI system Ataraxos has decisively beaten the best Stratego player of all time. The board game is a tough test for AI because both sides set up their pieces face down. Google Deepmind fell short in 2023 despite a multimillion-dollar budget. Researchers from Carnegie Mellon, NYU, Stanford, and MIT built Ataraxos for less than $8,000. The article AI beats Stratego's greatest player, ending one of the last human strongholds in board games appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: AI 系統 Ataraxos 已經決定性地擊敗了史上最強的《軍棋》（Stratego）玩家。這款桌上遊戲對 AI 來說是一大考驗，因為雙方都是將棋子正面朝下擺放。儘管擁有數百萬美元的預算，Google Deepmind 仍在 2023 年鎩羽而歸。來自卡內基美隆大學、紐約大學、史丹佛大學和麻省理工學院的研究人員以不到 8,000 美元的成本打造了 Ataraxos。「AI 擊敗《軍棋》最強玩家，終結了人類在桌上遊戲的最後堡壘之一」一文最初發表於 The Decoder。
